Logo Plot

plot_logo.Rd

Draw a logo plot for all glycosites. Positions with insufficient flanking amino acids will be padded with "X". Currently supported data types:

  • SummarizedExperiment: A glyexp::GlycoproteomicSE() or other compatible glycoproteomics container. Logo plot of glycosylation sites is plotted.

Usage

plot_logo(
  x,
  ...,
  n_aa = 5L,
  fasta = NULL,
  tax_id = 9606L,
  logo_args = list(),
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'glyexp_experiment'
plot_logo(
  x,
  ...,
  n_aa = 5L,
  fasta = NULL,
  tax_id = 9606L,
  logo_args = list(),
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'GlycoproteomicSE'
plot_logo(
  x,
  ...,
  n_aa = 5L,
  fasta = NULL,
  tax_id = 9606L,
  logo_args = list(),
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object to be plotted.

...

Must be empty. Supply plotting controls by their full argument names.

n_aa

The number of amino acids to the left and right of the glycosylation site. For example, if n_aa = 5, the resulting sequence will contain 11 amino acids.

fasta

The path to the FASTA file containing protein sequences. If glyclean::add_site_seq() has been called on the experiment, this argument can be omitted. When site_sequence is missing and fasta is NULL, UniProt.ws is used to fetch protein sequences automatically.

tax_id

The NCBI taxonomy ID used for UniProt.ws lookups. Defaults to 9606.

logo_args

Named list of glyph options passed to ggseqlogo::geom_logo(), for example list(method = "prob").

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to NULL.

width, height

Plot-area dimensions in millimetres. NULL uses the tidyplots defaults (50 by 50 mm); NA fills the available graphics device. These are not export-page dimensions.

fontsize

Base text size in points. Defaults to 9.

family

Font family. Defaults to "sans".

palette

Color vector. A named vector maps group names to fixed colors across plots and subsets; unnamed palettes follow factor order. NULL selects the plot-specific default: blue-white-red for continuous heatmaps, directional colors for volcano and S-plots, selection colors for ranked dot plots, and distinct hues for other plots.

Value

A tidyplot object, also inheriting from ggplot.
